faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIITDM Kancheepuram JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in the IIITDM Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026. Interested candidates should check the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIITDM Kancheepuram Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 is Online. Candidates must visit the official website to fill out and submit their applications electronically.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India norms for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will receive a salary of ₹ 37,000 per month, along with an additional 30% HRA. This makes it an attractive opportunity.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required for JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.E. / B.Tech. in CSE / IT / ECE with a valid GATE score or 2 years of industry experience in VLSI design, or an M.E. / M.Tech. in CSE / IT / ECE or relevant streams.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for IIITDM Kancheepuram JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIITDM Kancheepuram Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIITDM Kancheepuram involves a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates must qualify both stages for final selection.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is Chennai, Tamil Nadu. IIITDM Kancheepuram is located at Pincode 600127, offering a good work environment.
